pages.en: One morning, a postcard comes in the post. There is a picture of a beach on it. "It's from Sam!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 一天早上，邮差送来一张明信片，上面印着海滩的图片。“是 Sam 寄来的！”Lily 说。
pages.scene: Lily picking up a postcard with a beach picture from the doormat by the front door, Max sniffing it, morning light.

pages.en: Sam is on holiday with his family. He writes: "The sea is warm and I can swim every day. I want to send you a letter too."
pages.zh: Sam 正和家人一起度假。他写道：“海水很暖和，我每天都能游泳。我还想给你们写封信。”
pages.scene: Sam swimming happily in a blue sea near a sunny beach, his family on towels on the sand.

pages.en: Lily finds a pen and a nice card. She writes to Sam about Max and school. Then she puts it in an envelope and posts it.
pages.zh: Lily 找来一支笔和一张漂亮的卡片。她给 Sam 写了 Max 和学校的事，然后把卡片装进信封寄了出去。
pages.scene: Lily putting an envelope into a red post box on the street, Mum and Max beside her, a sunny day.

questions.q: The postcard has a picture of a mountain.
questions.zh: 明信片上是一座山的图片。

questions.q: What can Sam do every day?

questions.zh: Lily 给 Sam 写了回信。
